sql: SELECT Timestamp AS ts, ResourceAttributes['container.name'] AS container, Body AS body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= '2026-10-27 08:00:00' AND Timestamp < '2026-10-27 21:00:00' AND ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-pbt-1' AND ResourceAttributes['host.name']='lighthouse-nethermind-1' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name'] IN ('beacon','validator') AND match(Body, ' (CRIT|ERRO|ERROR|WARN) |(?i:execution (engine|endpoint|node|layer))') ORDER BY Timestamp
